This Petition Coming On For Preliminary Hearing,
This Day, The Court Made The Following:
 Order

The essential grievance of the Petitioner is as to non- mentioning of name in the acquisition proceedings Notifications though it has bought the subject property much before the said acquisition process began.

Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the figuring of name in the acquisition proceedings Records has got its own advantages and that such advantages are associated with the Right to Property constitutionally guaranteed under Article 300A.

This apart, he adds that when such a grievance is raised by a citizen through representation of the kind, it is the bounden duty of the authorities to consider the same in accordance with law and in a time bound way in terms of Article 350 of the Constitution.
2. Learned AGA appears for the 1st & 3rd Respondents and learned Sr. panel Counsel on request appears for Respondent No.2-Karnataka Road Development Corporation.

Both they oppose the Petition contending that if the Petitioners have got any grievance, they should seek redressal in the appropriate Court which may arguably be under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
